answer: An attacker flooding the ocean of agents with thousands of puppets must fund every bond, and each mirror account sees its stake slashed on detection. Sybil resistance here works through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond that decays with every attestation earned, so fake identities create a costly ripple across the ledger. Honest peers verify work history, making mass forgery more expensive than the rewards it could capture. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
